en: Color postcard showing a richly detailed church fresco depicting the Baptism of Jesus by John the Baptist in a river, surrounded by angels and other figures with golden halos. Below the scene runs a Latin inscription on a decorative band. The reverse side has multilingual captions (Hungarian, German, English, Russian) identifying the artwork, along with standard postcard address lines, stamp boxes, price, and publisher details in Hungarian.
